label: use_replica (read from replica)
type: the query setting permitting a query to read from replica vBuckets when actives are unavailable, requiring Couchbase Server 7.6.0 or later - and not applicable to sequential (KV range) scans, which cannot start on a replica vBucket.
evidence: Reading from replica is only possible if the cluster uses Couchbase Server 7.6.0 or later.
Note that KV range scans cannot currently be started on a replica vBucket. If a query uses sequential scan, it will not be able to read from a replica.
note: The sequential-scan exclusion is stated only on the cluster settings page, not on the query-settings reference that documents the setting - so an administrator enabling replica reads cluster-wide learns of the exception and a developer setting it per request does not.
